step1:person.text: {"task_id": "person", "step": "recipe", "grain": "One row per patient; person_id is a generated surrogate key, person_source_value is the business key from patients.Id.", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM patients AS b1"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": [], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": ["All required person attributes (GENDER, BIRTHDATE, RACE, ETHNICITY) are present in patients and not null.", "patients.Id is unique and will be used as person_source_value; person_id will be generated as a surrogate key ordered by person_source_value.", "No joins are required because all matched source columns come from the patients table.", "Concept mapping for gender_concept_id, race_concept_id, ethnicity_concept_id will be handled in a later formula step using concept_seed and concept_relationship_seed."], "keys": [{"column": "person_id", "order_by": ["person_source_value"]}]}

step1:observation_period.text: {"task_id": "observation_period", "step": "recipe", "grain": "One row per person, representing the observation period from the earliest encounter start date to the latest encounter stop date for that person.", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM patients p INNER JOIN encounters e ON p.Id = e.PATIENT"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": ["p.Id"], "decisions": {"joins": ["INNER JOIN encounters e ON p.Id = e.PATIENT"], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": true}, "assumptions": ["Observation period is inferred from encounters: start date is the minimum encounter START date cast to date, end date is the maximum encounter STOP date cast to date.", "person_id and observation_period_id are surrogate keys generated over the output rows; person_id is assigned per person based on a stable order of observation period dates.", "Only patients with at least one encounter are included; patients without encounters are dropped by the inner join."], "keys": [{"column": "person_id", "order_by": ["observation_period_start_date", "observation_period_end_date"]}, {"column": "observation_period_id", "order_by": ["person_id", "observation_period_start_date", "observation_period_end_date"]}]}

step1:visit_occurrence.text: {"task_id": "visit_occurrence", "step": "recipe", "grain": "One row per encounter (encounters.Id).", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM encounters AS e INNER JOIN patients AS p ON e.PATIENT = p.Id LEFT JOIN providers AS pr ON e.PROVIDER = pr.Id LEFT JOIN organizations AS o ON e.ORGANIZATION = o.Id"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": ["INNER JOIN patients on encounters.PATIENT = patients.Id (declared link)", "LEFT JOIN providers on encounters.PROVIDER = providers.Id (declared link)", "LEFT JOIN organizations on encounters.ORGANIZATION = organizations.Id (declared link)"], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": ["The grain is one encounter row; each encounter becomes one visit_occurrence.", "person_id is obtained from patients.Id and will be mapped to the person table surrogate key in a later step.", "provider_id and care_site_id are obtained from providers.Id and organizations.Id respectively and will be mapped to integer surrogate keys in a later step.", "visit_concept_id, visit_source_concept_id, and related concept fields are derived from ENCOUNTERCLASS using concept_seed and concept_relationship_seed in the formula step; no additional join is required for row generation.", "encounters.START and encounters.STOP are never null, so no rows are dropped due to missing dates."], "keys": [{"column": "visit_occurrence_id", "order_by": ["person_id", "visit_start_date", "visit_end_date", "visit_source_value"]}]}

step1:visit_detail.text: {"task_id": "visit_detail", "step": "recipe", "grain": "One row per encounter (encounters.Id), representing a visit detail.", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM encounters e LEFT JOIN patients p ON e.PATIENT = p.Id LEFT JOIN providers pr ON e.PROVIDER = pr.Id LEFT JOIN organizations o ON e.ORGANIZATION = o.Id"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": ["encounters LEFT JOIN patients ON encounters.PATIENT = patients.Id", "encounters LEFT JOIN providers ON encounters.PROVIDER = providers.Id", "encounters LEFT JOIN organizations ON encounters.ORGANIZATION = organizations.Id"], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": ["Each encounter produces exactly one visit_detail row.", "person_id is derived from patients.Id via a separate mapping not modeled here.", "provider_id is taken from providers.Id via encounters.PROVIDER.", "care_site_id is taken from organizations.Id via encounters.ORGANIZATION, treating organization as care site.", "visit_occurrence_id is derived from encounters.Id via a separate mapping not modeled here.", "visit_detail_concept_id is derived from encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS via a mapping to a standard Visit domain concept.", "No de-duplication is needed because encounters.Id is unique."], "keys": [{"column": "visit_detail_id", "order_by": ["visit_detail_start_date", "visit_detail_source_value", "person_id"]}]}

step1:measurement.text: {"task_id": "measurement", "step": "recipe", "grain": "One row per measurement event from observations or procedures, identified by patient, source code, and measurement date/time.", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM observations o INNER JOIN patients p ON o.PATIENT = p.Id INNER JOIN concept_seed c ON o.CODE = c.concept_code WHERE c.domain_id = 'Measurement'"}, {"id": "b2", "from": "FROM procedures pr INNER JOIN patients p ON pr.PATIENT = p.Id INNER JOIN concept_seed c ON pr.CODE = c.concept_code WHERE c.domain_id = 'Measurement'"}], "combine": "union_distinct", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": ["INNER JOIN patients to obtain person_id", "INNER JOIN concept_seed to map source code to standard concept and filter to Measurement domain"], "stacked": true, "deduplicated": true, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": ["Only observations and procedures are considered as sources for measurements.", "The source code (observations.CODE or procedures.CODE) is mapped to concept_seed via concept_code; only concepts with domain_id = 'Measurement' are retained.", "person_id is obtained by joining to patients on PATIENT = Id.", "Rows without a matching patient or concept are dropped (INNER JOIN).", "If the same measurement could arise from both branches, union_distinct removes duplicates.", "measurement_id is a generated surrogate key assigned after stacking and de-duplication."], "keys": [{"column": "measurement_id", "order_by": ["measurement_date", "person_id", "measurement_source_value"]}]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_con.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "std.concept_id"}], "uses": ["std.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["The inner join chain guarantees that each procedure occurrence has a matching standard concept with domain 'Procedure' and standard_concept='S', so std.concept_id is never NULL for rows that pass the join.", "The mapping from source concept to standard concept via concept_relationship_seed with relationship_id='Maps to' is unique per source concept, so no aggregation or deduplication is needed.", "Rows without a valid mapping are excluded by the inner joins, consistent with the requirement that only records mapping to standard Procedure concepts are loaded."]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_dat.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(p.START AS DATE)"}], "uses": ["p.START"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["p.START is not null (null rate 0.0), so casting to date yields a non-null date."]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_end.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_end_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(p.STOP AS DATE)"}], "uses": ["p.STOP"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["p.STOP is the procedure completion timestamp and is cast directly to a DATE for the end date.", "NULL values in p.STOP produce NULL in procedure_end_date, which is permitted because the target column is nullable.", "No fallback to p.START is applied; the matched STOP column is used as the source of the end date."]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_dat.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(p.START AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["p.START"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["p.START is the procedure start date/time and is never NULL in the source (null rate 0.0), so the expression never returns NULL; the target is nullable, so a NULL would be acceptable but does not occur here.", "The cast changes the type from TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE to TIMESTAMP by dropping the time-zone component (in DuckDB the instant is expressed in the session time zone and the zone is stripped); no trimming, recasing, or other normalization is applied."]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_end.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_end_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(p.STOP AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["p.STOP"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["The source column procedures.STOP holds the procedure completion datetime and is mapped directly to procedure_end_datetime.", "The source is TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE; it is cast to TIMESTAMP, dropping the time zone offset without conversion.", "NULL inputs are preserved as NULL because the target column is nullable."]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_sou.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_source_value", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "p.CODE"}], "uses": ["p.CODE"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["procedures.CODE is the verbatim source procedure code and is copied directly to procedure_source_value.", "p.CODE has a null rate of 0.0 in the source, so the expression does not introduce NULLs; the target column remains nullable per schema.", "Source CODE values are length 7-15, which fits within the target varchar(50) without truncation."]}

step2:device_exposure.device_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.device_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "cs_target.concept_id"}], "uses": ["cs_target.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["The inner joins in branch b1 ensure every device exposure has a valid 'Maps to' relationship to a Device domain concept, so cs_target.concept_id is never NULL.", "No fallback to 0 is applied; devices without a mapping would be excluded by the join.", "The expression copies the target concept id directly from concept_seed after relationship resolution."]}

step2:procedure_occurrence.procedure_sou.text: {"task_id": "procedure_occurrence.procedure_source_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "src.concept_id"}], "uses": ["src.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["The matched source column src.concept_id (concept_seed.concept_id) is the concept id for the source procedure code and is the correct value for procedure_source_concept_id per the OMOP convention (the source value's concept, not the standard concept).", "std.concept_id (the standard Procedure concept reached via 'Maps to') belongs to procedure_concept_id, not this field.", "The recipe uses INNER JOINs, so only procedure rows with a SNOMED source concept and an active 'Maps to' relationship to a standard Procedure concept are emitted; src.concept_id is NOT NULL for all emitted rows (concept_seed.concept_id is a PK with null rate 0.0).", "The target is nullable, but this branch never emits NULL; rows without a match are dropped by the recipe rather than mapped to NULL or to the special value 0.", "The concept_id value '0' present in concept_seed is treated as an ordinary concept id and is not specially converted."]}

step2:device_exposure.device_exposure_st.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.device_exposure_start_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(d.START AS DATE)"}], "uses": ["d.START"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["devices.START is not null for all rows (null rate 0.0), so the cast will not produce NULL.", "Casting a TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE to DATE extracts the calendar date component."]}

{"task_id": "device_exposure.device_exposure_start_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(d.START AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["d.START"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["devices.START is not null (null rate 0.0), so no NULL handling is required; casting from TIMESTAMPTZ to TIMESTAMP drops the time zone component; target is nullable so any NULL would be preserved as NULL."]}

step2:device_exposure.device_exposure_en.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.device_exposure_end_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(d.STOP AS DATE)"}], "uses": ["d.STOP"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["devices.STOP is nullable; when NULL the expression returns NULL, which is allowed for this nullable target field."]}

step2:device_exposure.unique_device_id.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.unique_device_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "d.UDI"}], "uses": ["d.UDI"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["The source column devices.UDI holds the UDI-DI value and is copied verbatim; no trimming, recasing, or normalization is applied.", "Source UDI values are at most 71 characters, so they fit within the target varchar(255) without truncation.", "The target column is nullable, so any NULL source UDI is passed through as NULL (the profiled source has null rate 0.0, but the expression remains NULL-safe).", "Rows are filtered by the recipe's inner join chain (devices -> concept mapping to Device domain); only joined rows produce output, and for those rows d.UDI is used directly."]}

step2:device_exposure.device_exposure_en.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.device_exposure_end_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(d.STOP AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["d.STOP"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["devices.STOP is used as the device exposure end datetime.", "The source column is TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE and is cast to TIMESTAMP, dropping the time zone.", "devices.STOP is NULL for every row in the profiled data, so the expression yields NULL for all rows, which is allowed because the target is nullable."]}

step2:device_exposure.device_source_valu.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.device_source_value", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "d.CODE"}], "uses": ["d.CODE"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["device_source_value is populated verbatim from devices.CODE, the source device code representing the device exposure.", "devices.CODE has null rate 0.0 and observed max length 9, so it fits within varchar(50) and no NULL handling or truncation is required; NULLs would pass through as allowed by the nullable target.", "No cast or transformation is applied; the value is copied faithfully as-is."]}

step2:device_exposure.device_source_conc.text: {"task_id": "device_exposure.device_source_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "cs.concept_id"}], "uses": ["cs.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["Branch b1 uses inner joins, so only device exposures with a matching concept_seed row for devices.CODE and a valid 'Maps to' relationship to a Device domain concept are included; rows without such mapping are not represented.", "cs.concept_id is the source concept id for the device code and is appropriate for device_source_concept_id.", "cs.concept_id is non-null per source metadata, so the expression never returns NULL for rows in this branch."]}

step2:measurement.measurement_date.text: {"task_id": "measurement.measurement_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(o.DATE AS DATE)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(pr.START AS DATE)"}], "uses": ["o.DATE", "pr.START"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["Source columns o.DATE and pr.START are non-null timestamps; casting to date extracts the calendar date without time zone adjustment."]}

step2:measurement.measurement_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "measurement.measurement_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "COALESCE(c.concept_id, 0)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "COALESCE(c.concept_id, 0)"}], "uses": ["c.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["concept_seed.concept_id is the standard concept id mapped from the source code and is used directly for both observations (b1) and procedures (b2).", "concept_seed.concept_id has a 0.0 null rate; COALESCE(..., 0) is applied to guarantee NOT NULL, using 0 = 'No matching concept' as the documented special value.", "source_to_concept_map_seed.target_concept_id is listed as a matched column but that table is not present in either recipe FROM clause, so it is not referenced.", "The WHERE c.domain_id = 'Measurement' filter ensures only Measurement-domain concepts are mapped, satisfying the target constraint."]}

step2:measurement.measurement_datetime.text: {"task_id": "measurement.measurement_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(o.DATE AS TIMESTAMP)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(pr.START AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["o.DATE", "pr.START"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["The matched datetime sources (observations.DATE, procedures.START) are TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE and have null rate 0.0, so they always provide a value; the target is nullable, so no NOT NULL handling is required.", "CAST(... AS TIMESTAMP) converts the TIMESTAMPTZ to a TIMESTAMP (DuckDB applies the session time zone and drops the offset); this copies the recorded date/time into the target type.", "The documented convention (NULL when no datetime is specified) is met because the sources are never NULL; a NULL source would cast to NULL.", "No join, filter, DISTINCT, or GROUP BY is added; branches are combined by the recipe's union_distinct."]}

step2:measurement.value_as_number.text: {"task_id": "measurement.value_as_number", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "TRY_CAST(o.VALUE AS NUMERIC)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)"}], "uses": ["o.VALUE"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["For branch b1, observations.VALUE is cast to NUMERIC using TRY_CAST; non-numeric strings yield NULL, which is allowed because the target is nullable.", "For branch b2, procedures have no value column, so value_as_number is NULL.", "No trimming or normalization is applied to VALUE before casting."]}

step2:measurement.measurement_time.text: {"task_id": "measurement.measurement_time", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "substring(CAST(o.DATE AS VARCHAR) FROM 12 FOR 8)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "substring(CAST(pr.START AS VARCHAR) FROM 12 FOR 8)"}], "uses": ["o.DATE", "pr.START"], "class": "date_extract", "assumptions": ["Source timestamps are always the profiled 25-character form \"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+05:30\", so the wall-clock time is at characters 12-19 (\"HH:MM:SS\", 8 characters).", "The extracted \"HH:MM:SS\" (8 characters) satisfies measurement_time's varchar(10) / max-length-10 rule, so no truncation or padding is applied.", "measurement_time is nullable, but observations.DATE and procedures.START have null rate 0.0, so the expression never returns NULL; no NULL handling is required.", "The time-zone offset is dropped and only the local wall-clock time is carried over, consistent with the field being a backwards-compatible/deprecated time-only column.", "Each branch uses its own matched timestamp column: o.DATE for observations (b1) and pr.START for procedures (b2)."]}

step2:measurement.value_as_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "measurement.value_as_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "c.concept_id"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "c.concept_id"}], "uses": ["c.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["concept_seed.concept_id is used as the mapped concept for the value; the source_to_concept_map_seed table is not part of the recipe, so the 'Maps to value' relationship cannot be applied; all rows are treated as having a categorial result with a mapping, so NULL or 0 are not returned; if no categorial result exists, the expression would need to return NULL, but that condition cannot be determined from the available columns."]}

step2:measurement.measurement_source_val.text: {"task_id": "measurement.measurement_source_value", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "o.CODE"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "pr.CODE"}], "uses": ["o.CODE", "pr.CODE"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["observations.CODE (LOINC) and procedures.CODE (SNOMED-CT) are the exact source values representing the measurement, retained as measurement_source_value per OMOP convention.", "All CODE values are 15 characters or fewer, within the varchar(50) limit, so no truncation or normalization is applied.", "Source CODE columns have null rate 0.0, so no NULLs are expected; if a NULL occurred it would pass through unchanged because the target is nullable."]}

step2:measurement.unit_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "measurement.unit_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CASE WHEN o.UNITS IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)"}], "uses": ["o.UNITS"], "class": "conditional", "assumptions": ["The recipe does not include a source_to_concept_map_seed join, so unit values cannot be mapped to a concept_id; any non-null unit is treated as unmapped and set to 0 per the convention.", "For procedures there is no unit column, so unit_concept_id is set to NULL.", "concept_seed.concept_id is the measurement concept, not the unit concept, and is not used for this field."]}

step2:measurement.measurement_source_con.text: {"task_id": "measurement.measurement_source_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "c.concept_id"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "c.concept_id"}], "uses": ["c.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["concept_seed.concept_id directly supplies measurement_source_concept_id per OMOP conventions for coded source values.", "The INNER JOIN to concept_seed guarantees a non-null concept_id for every retained row, though the target column is nullable.", "No cast is required because concept_seed.concept_id is already INTEGER."]}

step2:measurement.unit_source_value.text: {"task_id": "measurement.unit_source_value", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "o.UNITS"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))"}], "uses": ["o.UNITS"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["The target column is nullable, so NULL values in observations.UNITS are passed through without coercion.", "All observed UNITS values are at most 8 characters, so they fit within varchar(50) and no truncation is applied.", "The procedures branch (b2) has no source column for units, so it returns NULL cast to varchar(50).", "Values are copied exactly as stored; no trimming, recasing, or vocabulary normalization is performed."]}

step2:measurement.value_source_value.text: {"task_id": "measurement.value_source_value", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "o.VALUE"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))"}], "uses": ["o.VALUE"], "class": "multi_source_expr", "assumptions": ["For observations (b1), the verbatim value is taken from observations.VALUE.", "For procedures (b2), there is no value column in the source table, so NULL is returned.", "The OMOP convention about storing the verbatim value mapped to VALUE_AS_CONCEPT_ID when both continuous and categorical results are present does not apply because the source tables do not contain VALUE_AS_NUMBER or VALUE_AS_CONCEPT_ID columns.", "All values in observations.VALUE are within 50 characters, so no truncation is applied."]}

step2:observation.observation_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "observation.observation_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, cs.concept_id)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, cs.concept_id)"}, {"branch": "b3", "sql": "COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, cs.concept_id)"}], "uses": ["cs.concept_id", "cr.concept_id_2"], "class": "conditional", "assumptions": ["The inner join to concept_seed guarantees cs.concept_id is not null.", "cr.concept_id_2 is the target concept of a 'Maps to' relationship; if absent, fall back to the source concept id.", "No cast is needed because both columns are integer.", "The expression never returns NULL, satisfying the NOT NULL constraint."]}

step2:observation.observation_date.text: {"task_id": "observation.observation_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(o.DATE AS DATE)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "a.START"}, {"branch": "b3", "sql": "c.START"}], "uses": ["o.DATE", "a.START", "c.START"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["Source columns o.DATE, a.START, c.START are not null per data profile (null rate 0.0), so the expression will not return NULL.", "For branch b1, casting TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE to DATE extracts the calendar date; no timezone conversion is applied beyond the timestamp's own date component."]}

All CODE values are within 50 characters and are non-null, so no casting or null handling is required."]}

step2:observation.observation_datetime.text: {"task_id": "observation.observation_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(o.DATE AS TIMESTAMP)"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)"}, {"branch": "b3", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["o.DATE"], "class": "multi_source_expr", "assumptions": ["Branch b1 source observations.DATE is TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE and is cast to TIMESTAMP, dropping the time zone.", "Branches b2 and b3 source columns allergies.START and conditions.START are DATE only with no time component; per the documented convention, if no time is given the value is set to NULL.", "NULL handling: o.DATE has null rate 0.0; a.START and c.START have null rate 0.0 but are intentionally overridden to NULL due to missing time."]}

step2:observation.observation_source_con.text: {"task_id": "observation.observation_source_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "cs.concept_id"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "cs.concept_id"}, {"branch": "b3", "sql": "cs.concept_id"}], "uses": ["cs.concept_id"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["The observation_source_concept_id is taken directly from concept_seed.concept_id, which represents the source vocabulary concept for the observation.", "The inner join to concept_seed guarantees that cs.concept_id is not null for every row, so no NULL handling is required.", "The concept_relationship_seed mapping is not used for this field; it would be relevant for observation_concept_id (standard concept) rather than the source concept."]}

step2:death.death_date.text: {"task_id": "death.death_date", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "p.DEATHDATE"}], "uses": ["p.DEATHDATE"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["Branch b1 filters WHERE p.DEATHDATE IS NOT NULL, so p.DEATHDATE is never NULL for rows that reach the expression, satisfying the NOT NULL constraint on death.death_date.", "The listed matched column encounters.START is not available in branch b1 because the branch FROM clause only includes patients p, so p.DEATHDATE is used as the source for death_date.", "The value is copied faithfully without trimming, recasing, or date normalization; the documented December/last-day convention is not applied because a precise, non-null DEATHDATE is already available."]}

step2:death.cause_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "death.cause_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)"}], "uses": [], "class": "null_placeholder", "assumptions": ["The recipe branch b1 exposes only the patients table (alias p), and none of its columns identify a cause of death concept.", "The matched columns concept_seed.concept_id and source_to_concept_map_seed.target_concept_id reference tables not present in the recipe FROM clause, so they cannot be referenced in the expression.", "death.cause_concept_id is nullable, so NULL is an acceptable value and is returned cast to INTEGER.", "No value such as 0 (No matching concept) is inferred because there is no source concept to evaluate against; returning NULL faithfully represents missing information."]}

step2:death.cause_source_value.text: {"task_id": "death.cause_source_value", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))"}], "uses": [], "class": "null_placeholder", "assumptions": ["Recipe branch b1 exposes only the patients table (alias p) filtered on DEATHDATE; it does not join encounters, so encounters.REASONCODE cannot be referenced per the fixed recipe and the rule to use only the branch's aliases and columns.", "No column in patients represents the cause of death, so no non-NULL source value is available for death.cause_source_value.", "The target column is nullable, so returning NULL is valid.", "The NULL is cast to VARCHAR(50) to match the target type and satisfy the max length 50 rule."]}

step2:death.cause_source_concept_id.text: {"task_id": "death.cause_source_concept_id", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)"}], "uses": [], "class": "null_placeholder", "assumptions": ["The recipe branch b1 only exposes the patients table; the matched concept_seed and source_to_concept_map_seed tables are not part of the branch FROM clause, so no cause-of-death concept source column is available. cause_source_concept_id is nullable, so the expression returns CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) for every deceased patient row."]}

step2:death.death_datetime.text: {"task_id": "death.death_datetime", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(p.DEATHDATE AS TIMESTAMP)"}], "uses": ["p.DEATHDATE"], "class": "retype", "assumptions": ["Branch b1 exposes only the patients table (alias p); the listed matched column encounters.START cannot be used because encounters is not in the branch FROM clause and no join is permitted by the fixed recipe.", "The only death information available in patients is p.DEATHDATE (DATE); the branch filter WHERE p.DEATHDATE IS NOT NULL guarantees a non-null input for every row in b1.", "p.DEATHDATE is cast to TIMESTAMP; because no time-of-death is stored in patients, the time portion becomes 00:00:00 (midnight).", "The target is nullable, but the cast yields a non-null timestamp for all rows in this branch since p.DEATHDATE is not null."]}

step2:location.city.text: {"task_id": "location.city", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "o.CITY"}, {"branch": "b2", "sql": "p.CITY"}], "uses": ["o.CITY", "p.CITY"], "class": "copy_or_rename", "assumptions": ["Branch b1 copies organizations.CITY (o.CITY) directly; branch b2 copies patients.CITY (p.CITY) directly.", "Values are copied faithfully with no case normalization, trimming, or recasing; organizations cities are uppercase and patients cities are mixed case as in the source.", "All observed city values are shorter than 50 characters (max 18), so no truncation to varchar(50) is required.", "The target column is nullable, so NULL source city values are passed through as NULL.", "The union_distinct combination deduplicates identical location rows across the two branches; city is part of the location grain."]}
